questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statement(s) is/are false regarding promise chain in javascript language?
options: A promise chain may consist of a number of “then” blocks.
A “finally” block always comes at the end of the promise chain.
Every “catch” block must always be preceded by a “then” block.
The “finally” block always gets executed, irrespective of the promise outcome.
correct_answer: A “finally” block always comes at the end of the promise chain.
Every “catch” block must always be preceded by a “then” block.
